package dailyassignments;

public class SkipEvenNoUsingContBreak {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		
		/*
		 * Skip Even Numbers
Write a Java program to print numbers from 1 to 20 using a do-while loop.
Requirements:
- Use continue to skip all even numbers.
- Print only odd numbers.
- Use break to stop the loop when the number becomes greater than 15.
Expected Output:
1
		 */
		int Num = 1;
		
		do
		{					
			
			if(Num%2==0)//1false
			{
				Num++;//3//5//7//9//11, 13,15,17,19
				continue;
			}
			if(Num>15)//3, 5,7, 9, 11, 
			{
				break;
			}
			System.out.print(Num+" ");//1, 3, 5, 7, 9
			Num++;//2//4//6, 8,10,12,14, 16, 18
			
		}while(Num<=20);
	
	
	}

}
